Mr. B.D. Upadhyay, learned Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Tushar Upadhyay, learned counsel for the

2. This contempt petition has been filed under Section
12 of The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 alleging willful
and deliberate contempt of Division Bench's order dated
03.06.2026, whereby the respondent-contemnor no.1 was
directed to decide the representation of the petitioner
dated 31.03.2026 within a period of three weeks' from the
date of communication of the order along with copy of the
said representation.
3. Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the
petitioner is taken on record.
4. Petitioner has forwarded the copy of the order as well
as the representation to the respondent-contemnor
through speed post on 05.06.2026 and modification
application on 16.06.2026.
5. Both items were delivered to the respondent-contemnor as reflected from the postal tracking report
annexed along with supplementary affidavit.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that
despite full knowledge of the order and service of the
representation as well as the order passed by Writ Court
the representation dated 31.05.2026 has yet not been

2
decided.
7. Issue notice to the respondent-contemnor returnable
within four weeks.
8. Steps to be taken within three days.
9. List this case on 07.09.2026.
10. In the meantime, respondent-contemnor may file
response or comply with the order.
